name: MENT 3235
title: Venture Planning, Management, and Growth
description: (Also offered as BADM 3235.) An exposure to multiple facets of starting and managing new ventures in a very hands-on fashion.  The course involves an integration of business skills that are required for preparing and pitching new business plans.
requirement_description: Open only to Business majors of junior or higher status. Recommended preparation: MENT 3234 or BADM 3234; MENT 3101 or BADM 3740; and ACCT or BADM 2101.
